body:
AGENTS.md's pr-area-labels entry repeats the stale claim that an area-less in-flight PR maps to __global__ and defers every issue without distinguishing PLAN occupancy (reserves nothing) from CLAIM (reserves __global__). Reconcile it with scripts/ready-issues.py and ci/area-labels.toml.

> 🤖 Discovered by the SPARQ worker while implementing #4926. Out-of-scope for that PR; captured as follow-up.

title: Correct PLAN versus CLAIM rationale in AGENTS.md
